description: This header file defines the API for TR-069 device IP diagnostics trace route functionalities, including getters and setters for various trace route parameters, but contains no implementation code.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Retrieves the current diagnostics state, indicating availability of diagnostic data.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Gets the IP-layer interface over which the trace route test is performed.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Gets the host name or address for the route trace.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of tries per hop for the trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout in milliseconds for each hop.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Gets the size of data block sent in each trace route packet.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Retrieves the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value used.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Gets maximum hop count (TTL) used in probe packets.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_ResponseTime
methods.description: Provides the response time of the most recent trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHopsNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Gets the number of entries in the RouteHops table.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the diagnostics state to request or manage trace route tests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Sets the IP-layer interface for trace route testing.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Sets the host name or address for route tracing.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Sets the number of tries per hop.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for each hop.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Sets the size of data block for each trace route probe.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the DSCP value for test packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum hop (TTL) count for probes.
